verdict.rationale: Databricks documents first-party notebooks with multi-language support and built-in data visualizations. A notebook can be attached to a SQL warehouse to run SQL alongside Python, Scala, or R, and the getting-started docs show querying Unity Catalog data and visualizing the results inline in a notebook. A hands-on community report praises the integrated visualizations, and the community criticism in the pack is about cost, serverless limits and security, not notebooks. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on confirmation of mixing SQL and Python in the same notebook against a SQL warehouse specifically.
